accepted_claims: Ferudun's Sigma(30,47,83) is a counterexample to the strong geography restriction over F2 for both orientations.
The total ungraded F2[U]-module HF-minus, summed over all Spin-c structures, has torsion length 16 and zero length-15 cyclic direct summands.
The example is an integral homology sphere with a unique Spin-c structure; there are 853 finite cyclic summands with total dimension 4864.
